description: Shared cases for design_items (packages/aia_core/src/aia_core/domain/design_items.py) and the web's proposalDiff / questionnaireReplacement / briefFingerprint (apps/web/src/research/proposal-diff.items.test.ts). Each case's items are the keys design_items returns, as document:kind:key. Fictional content. Each merge's merged is merge_items(proposed, current, design_items(base, proposed)); the web has no merge, so only the server reads them.

cases.name: unchanged
cases.note: Nothing differs: no item.

cases.name: brief_goal
cases.note: A brief field is one item.

cases.name: briefing_field
cases.note: Each briefing field is its own item.

cases.name: objective_added_removed
cases.note: An objective added and one removed, in the plan and the analysis alike.

cases.name: respelled_question
cases.note: A research question respelled (case, whitespace) is not a change.

cases.name: hypothesis_replaced
cases.note: A hypothesis replaced: the old one goes, the new one comes.

cases.name: tracked_set_objects
cases.note: A tracked set's objects changed: the set, keyed by its title, is the item.

cases.name: tracked_set_added
cases.note: A new tracked set is a new item.

cases.name: problem_summary
cases.note: The problem summary is one field of the plan and of the analysis.

cases.name: question_text
cases.note: A question's wording changed: the question, by its id.

cases.name: question_added
cases.note: A question added to a section: the question and the section that now holds it.

cases.name: question_removed
cases.note: A question removed: the question and its section.

cases.name: battery_objects
cases.note: A battery's objects changed: the battery, whole.

cases.name: audience
cases.note: The audience is one item.

cases.name: dimensions
cases.note: The dimension selection is one item.

cases.name: sample_size
cases.note: The sample size is one item.

cases.name: other_field
cases.note: Any other top-level field is an item of its own, so nothing falls between items.

cases.name: analysis_only_field
cases.note: An analysis field outside the plan's lists.

cases.name: duplicate_set_titles
cases.note: Two sets of one title stay two items; editing the second names it as <title>#2.

cases.name: reordered
cases.note: Sections and research questions reordered: order is no item.

merges.name: keeps_the_persons_order
merges.note: The person reordered sections and research questions; the proposal adds a question and a research question. The merge keeps the person's order and puts each new entry after its predecessor in the proposal.
